newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Eletropaulo to issue $60 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Eletropaulo to issue $60 mln debt.

text.p: Sao Paulo state power firm Eletropaulo will launch within a month a one-year commercial paper program of up to $60 million, a company official said.

The issue, the second tranche of a total $200 million commercial paper program, will pay under 10 percent a year plus the exchange rate variation, said Henrique Fingermann, the firm's financial director.
This issue will be coordinated by Banco do Brasil's unit BB Securities and will allow the firm to lengthen the maturity period of part of its $1.0 billion debt, he said.

In August, Eletropaulo issued its first tranche of $30 million in six-month commecial paper. That tranche paid 10.5 percent a year plus the exchange rate variation, he said. He said the firm was planning not only to roll over the $30 million debt maturing in February but also expand the issue.
Fingermann also said the firm was planning to securitize by the end of the year part of its receivables which total nearly $450 million a month.
